header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the petitioner nor any intimation received. This petition was
body: filed in the year 2021 and was lastly fixed in the court on 19.11.2025, where on that date, brief was held on behalf of the counsel for petitioner, but thereafter no efforts were made to proceed with the same.

The perusal of prayer clause reflects that this petition was filed for getting the admission in the Medical College. However, the perusal of the record reveals that subsequently several processes were initiated and finalized for the admission and by way of passing of sufficient time, this petition has become infructuous and is hereby disposed of.
